title: The Best Thread Door and Window Sensors
subtitle: Thread contact sensors that work through Matter with every major smart home system, ranked.
intro: We pulled the door and window sensors on Amazon whose listings name Thread and scored them on rating, review volume, and features.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: Eve Door & Window (Matter)
awards.why: Highest score (73) among picks with at least 4.0 stars and 30 reviews: 4.1 stars from 150 reviews, $40.99.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.name: Aqara Multi-State Sensor P100
awards.why: Highest score (77) among the cheapest third of picks (up to $27.99 each): 3.1 stars from 132 reviews, $27.99.

systems_note: Every sensor here runs on Thread and joins your system through Matter. You need a Thread border router such as a recent Apple TV, HomePod, Nest Hub, or Echo.

products.name: Aqara Multi-State Sensor P100, Door and Window & Vibration Sensor, White
products.verdict: One sensor for doors, windows, and knocks or tilts on objects like a mailbox or safe.
cons: Vibration tuning takes trial and error

products.name: Eve Door & Window (Matter) Smart Contact Sensor, Matter over Thread, Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home, SmartThings
products.verdict: Eve's local-only Matter-over-Thread contact sensor, with no cloud account needed.

products.name: Aqara Door and Window Sensor P2, Contact Sensor with Remote Alarm
products.verdict: Aqara's Thread sensor, which needs no Aqara hub.
cons: Aqara app features limited without a hub

products.name: arre Contact Sensor, Matter over Thread, Works with Apple Home, Google Home and SmartThings
products.verdict: A Matter-certified contact sensor from a smaller brand.

buyers_guide.a: A Thread border router, which is built into recent Apple TVs and HomePods, Nest Hubs, some Echo models, and SmartThings and Aqara hubs. With Matter, the device then shows up in Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, or Home Assistant.

buyers_guide.q: How do door and window sensors work?
buyers_guide.a: A magnet goes on the door or window and the sensor goes on the frame. When the two separate, the sensor reports open. Mount them within the gap the listing specifies, usually under an inch.

buyers_guide.q: How long do the batteries last?
buyers_guide.a: Most battery sensors on these lists are rated for one to three years, depending on how often they report. Low-power radios like Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Thread last much longer than Wi-Fi.

buyers_guide.q: Can I use these as a security system?
buyers_guide.a: They can trigger alerts and sirens through your smart home system, but they aren't a monitored alarm. For insurance discounts or police dispatch you need a professionally monitored system.
